name: Misshitsu no Sacrifice ~Miki: High Tension Night~
original_name: 密室のサクリファイス～ミキ：ハイテンションナイト～
source:
A spin-off work featuring the beautiful girl "Miki" who appears in Misshitsu no Sacrifice. A slapstick adventure that tries to escape from a closed space in cooperation with Miki who is met at the physical education warehouse. Equipped with a scan function in addition to the hint function.

[Translated from [url=https://www.d3p.co.jp/site/sacrifice_miki]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
以《未失之牺牲》中登场的美少女“美纪”为主角的衍生作品。与在体育仓库遇见的美纪合作，试图逃离封闭空间的闹剧冒险。除提示功能外，还配备扫描功能。

[译自[url=https://www.d3p.co.jp/site/sacrifice_miki]官方网站[/url]]
